reuse: Same Comfy FLF2V graph for S04 door-drop and S10 flag-plant. Change first_image, last_image, positive_action and seed only. Do not fork a new workflow JSON per shot.

policy.other_shots_default: I2V via workflow/02_i2v_wan21_480p.json + workflow/02_i2v_api_prompt_r1_r4.json; FLF2V is not a default for other shots
policy.after_two_failures: change strategy (fix first/last frame, switch to I2V, or use static + Ken Burns); never reseed the same parameters

first_image.title: Start_image
first_image.role: Accepted same-identity looklock frame at the start of the key action; must pass H1 before FLF2V.

last_image.title: End_image
last_image.role: Accepted same-identity looklock frame at the action payoff; identity must match first_image.

positive_action.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
positive_action.rules: action starts at frame 0; strong verbs only; ban gentle/slightly/small/soft/subtle/barely; include identity lock and single-character constraints

first_frame.content: Same-identity cat soldier inside LCVP, right paw gripping the closed steel ramp handle, door not yet down

last_frame.content: Same identity stepping forward as the steel ramp slams into the surf, cold spray across frame

S04.positive: Exactly one anthropomorphic orange-white cat soldier in US WWII Normandy gear. At frame 0 she grips the LCVP ramp handle and shoves the steel ramp down hard; the ramp slams into the surf, cold water sprays across the frame, she steps forward into the water. Fixed low-angle camera, medium shot. Same face, fur pattern, helmet and red neckerchief as the first frame. Only one character, no extra soldiers, no text, no extra limbs.

last_frame.content: Same identity driving the staff into the sand with the flag at the top, clean silhouette, backlit dust

S10.positive: Exactly one anthropomorphic orange-white cat soldier in US WWII Normandy gear. Fixed low-angle wide-to-medium camera. Same face, fur pattern, helmet and red neckerchief as the first frame. Only one character, no extra soldiers, no text, no extra limbs.
